result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a signalized crossing, but the crosswalk markings are significantly faded. The wide roadway geometry and lack of curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure to traffic in a mixed-use urban setting.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are heavily worn, reducing visibility for approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection lacks curb extensions, forcing pedestrians to spend more time exposed to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the width of the main street

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear in the asphalt surface within the intersection area.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten crossing distance and improve sight lines.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a marked zebra crosswalk and a sidewalk on the residential side of the street. However, the crossing is uncontrolled and lacks signage, and the absence of a sidewalk on the opposite side creates a gap in the pedestrian network.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks any pedestrian warning signage or signals to alert approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no paved sidewalk on the right side of the street, forcing pedestrians onto unpaved surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian crossing warning signs to alert motorists of the crossing location.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk network to the right side of the street to provide a continuous and safe path for pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide roadway passing under a large overpass with minimal crossing infrastructure. While sidewalks are present, the lack of marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals at a signalized intersection creates a high-risk environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at this signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross an unmarked, wide roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area

hazards.name: Poor Visibility Underpass
hazards.description: The dark area under the bridge combined with large concrete piers creates shadows and visual obstructions that can hide pedestrians from drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of image under the bridge structure

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of clear lane markings and the width of the road under the bridge may encourage higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable lane positioning.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway surface leading into the underpass

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks across all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic signal infrastructure.

interventions.title: Underpass Lighting
interventions.description: Improve lighting levels specifically under the bridge structure to eliminate dark spots and improve visibility of pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection lacks fundamental pedestrian infrastructure, including marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals, despite being signalized for vehicles. Sidewalks are either absent or in very poor condition, creating a hostile environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated path.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian signal heads are visible, meaning pedestrians have no clear indication of when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: On the traffic signal poles

hazards.name: Poor Sidewalk Infrastructure
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right is degraded and unpaved in sections, while the left side lacks a paved walkway entirely.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental or ladder-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals and improve safety at the signalized intersection.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction and Repair
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, paved sidewalk network with ADA-compliant curb ramps on both sides of the street.
